title: evaluation/1: a case of an agent's evaluation set
description: A file tests/evaluation/<name>.yml of an agent (plan 27a AG23): the task the agent is given, fixtures that go with it, and what a good result is. The reader (EvaluationCaseLoader) is the authority; a test keeps this file's keys equal to the reader's.

fixtures.description: Named texts that go with the task.

pass-at.description: The score at which the case counts as passed.

expect.description: What a good result is. The suite decides every check but the rubric, which a judge model reads against the written text.

rows-match-verified-query.description: The id of a verified query: the rows of the agent's query are compared with its rows.

check.description: A check the host knows by name, such as workspace-compiles.

rubric.description: Free text judged by the judge model.
